title: Digital Zoom
summary: Punch-in zooms with zoom blur on the key words.
description: The footage snaps in (and back out) on emphasised words with a short radial zoom blur, like a camera punch-in. In auto mode it punches on the same words the captions highlight, alternating in and out, never closer than minGap seconds apart.

options.punches: "auto", or a list like [{"at": "@video", "scale": 1.3}, {"at": "@editing", "scale": 1.0}]. "at" takes seconds or "@word".
options.scale: zoom level for auto punch-ins (1.3 = 30% closer)
options.rest: zoom level between punches (1.0 = original framing)
options.transitionFrames: frames the snap takes (3-6 feels like a punch)
options.blur: radial zoom blur during the snap (true/false)
options.focus: "face" to zoom toward the face, or [x, y] as 0-1 fractions of the frame
